about_the_game:
A fast-paced and dynamic blackjack experience, set against dark-themed tables and adorned with epic hero battles!

In the heat of a tie, fate is decided by a coin toss. Each round offers unique combinations, and with just three intense turns, every match becomes a thrilling clash of wits and luck!

Feel the power in every strike!

With distinct classes, custom effects, and immersive sound design, every move places you right in the heart of battle.

Each character reflects a unique playstyle, and the rhythm of combat shifts accordingly.

A unique atmosphere shaped by dark-themed tables that evolve as you level up!

As you progress, the ambiance transforms, and each level introduces a new table with its own dark and immersive theme.

Every stage opens the door to a deeper, more mysterious, and more captivating experience.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris 5100 / 5200 or AMD Radeon R9 M370X (Metal-supported GPUs)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in sound card (macOS compatible)
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard + mouse (or touchpad)

name: Blackjack Wars

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: i3-2100 veya AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti veya AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Playable with keyboard and mouse (or touchpad)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: A fast-paced, dynamic, and extraordinary blackjack experience set on dark-themed tables, blended with epic hero battles! With fate decided by coin tosses, three-round short matches, and diverse table combinations, prepare for breathless battles where wit and luck collide.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish
